info.name: Poke API - US04 Local Data Modification (CRUD)
info.description:
Black-box tests for US04 (create, update and delete local Pokémon, with validation) against the dockerized app with the demo profile and live PokeAPI. Re-runnable: it edits #2 ivysaur and creates and deletes its own local Pokémon.

Run: `docker compose run --rm api-tests`.
